_note: How the final score is made (Phase 8). Change numbers here - no code change. Raise 'version' on every change; it is saved with every check. Tuned with real data in phase L1.

mira._note: MIRA points = scam_weight*P(scam) + spam_weight*P(ad) + question_scale*question points; can be negative for clearly normal messages
mira._note_max_points: s2: MIRA alone can add at most max_points, so on its own it can reach Suspicious but never Dangerous - Dangerous always needs a fact (bad link, OTX, new domain, brand mismatch, OTP request).

hard_rules._note: otp_and_unofficial_link: asks for OTP/PIN and has a non-official link -> at least Dangerous. trusted_sender_official_only: registered company sender, only official links (or none), asks for nothing -> at most Safe.
